column1: # The Python port's hand-decided names: old <TAB> new (new == old keeps the name).
# Words with more than one meaning (fp, gp, op, int, hi/lo), decided as in the C core.
# Port-only words: the CPU object's coprocessor register banks, the Cause field, a list of ints.
# Kept: the CPU state object and its class (not the CpU exception code), the R/I/J formats,
# the grammar shapes (b2, i2, r3), English words, numeric type helpers, and termios's flags.
# The exception-code members share spellings with other names (CPU is also the CPU class),
# so the token pass keeps them and a targeted pass renames ExceptionCode.<member>.
